answer: Stop sybils with a work-bonded kernel registry. First, each agent publishes its kernel, a hash of its model and hardware, and locks a $200 bond for 90 days. Second, every week it must finish an assigned verification job within 24 hours, or lose $25 of its bond. Third, seven random peers audit its work monthly, re-running one job; one mismatch slashes the full bond and bans that kernel forever. Forging 10,000 fakes then costs $2,000,000 in bonds, 10,000 distinct kernels, and 70,000 audits it cannot fake. Like a lantern carried across a saffron oasis, each kernel lights exactly one path.
